verdict.rationale: Mastra documents human-in-the-loop suspend/resume for workflows: a workflow can pause and await user input or approval before resuming, which is a form of feeding data into a specific running workflow. Workflows are also served from a Mastra server. However, the evidence never shows resume or signal being triggered via an external API call, webhook, or another workflow. MCP events are documented only as starting new workflow runs, and webhook routing is described for agent threads, not running workflows. missing for 10: documented external API/webhook endpoint for signaling or resuming a specific running workflow run, workflow-to-workflow signaling, arbitrary event/signal delivery beyond suspend-resume, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I send signals, events, or messages into a specific running workflow from outside — an API call, webhook, or another workflow

citations.quote: Mastra workflows also support human-in-the-loop functionality, allowing developers to suspend a workflow and await user input or approval before resuming.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
